description: Contains unit tests for the AsyncExecutorWithRetries utility class in Orleans, focusing on its retry logic, error handling, and success filters during asynchronous execution.

classes.name: Async_AsyncExecutorWithRetriesTests
classes.description: Test suite for the AsyncExecutorWithRetries utility in Orleans, verifying retry behaviors, error filtering, and success conditions.

methods.name: Async_AsyncExecutorWithRetriesTest_1
methods.description: Tests that the retry mechanism successfully retries a transient failure until success and handles max retries exceeded.

methods.name: Async_AsyncExecutorWithRetriesTest_2
methods.description: Verifies that the success filter halts retries once a success condition is met within specified retry limits.

methods.name: Async_AsyncExecutorWithRetriesTest_4
methods.description: Ensures that when the function succeeds initially, the error filter is not invoked.

methods.name: Async_AsyncExecutorWithRetriesTest_5
methods.description: Tests the behavior of the error filter when it returns true, false, or throws an exception, affecting retry continuation.
